title: Arcane Agility
summary: Arcane Agility is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 60% chance whenever the player receives damage to increase Warframe parkour velocity for 18 seconds.
extract:
Arcane Agility is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 60% chance whenever the player receives damage to increase Warframe parkour velocity for 18 seconds.
Can be sold for  500.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Gantulyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Pluto Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.
Awarded at Tier 9 of The Circuit on Normal Mode for Week 2.

History
Arcane Agility was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Agility from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Agility from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Agility from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 5  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Agility from Ordis for 3  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 4 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Agility from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 2  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).
